name: Sika Boom AP
paste:
SIKA BOOM® AP: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika Boom® AP, January 2025, Version 03.04 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/sika_boom_ap.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika Boom® AP where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2025, Version 03.04).
1.2 Product description. Sika Boom® AP a one-component, fast curing, general purpose polyurethane foam with a very high expansion. Sika Boom® AP is suitable for multi-position application in hard to reach application areas.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Sika Boom® AP is designed for fixing, insulating and filling cavities, voids and connection joints around window and door frames, air-conditioning vents, roller blind housings, pipe and conduit penetrations for internal and external use.
    - Sika Boom® AP provides insulation against temperature, noise, wind draughts and vermin after application.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.6.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika Boom® AP
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: MULTI-POSITION, HIGH YIELD EXPANDING FOAM
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - KS M 3809 : 2021
    - GBCA V1.3-13.1.1B & V1.3-12.1.1B
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ASTM D3960: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Green building (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - One-Component
    - Multi-position application
    - Easy application with nozzle
    - High expansion rate
    - Fast curing
    - Very good thermal insulation
    - Effective sound dampening
    - Can be cut and over painted
    - HFC-free
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Polyurethane
    - Colour: Light Yellow
    - Density: ~23 kg/m³
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Green building: 3grams/litre as VOC content (ASTM D3960)
    - Thermal conductivity: ~0.033 W/mK (KS M 3809 : 2021)
    - Service temperature: −40 °C min. / +90 °C max.
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Available in 500ml, 750ml & 850ml
    - Storage conditions: Sika Boom® AP shall be stored in an upright position, in dry conditions, protected from direct sunlight and at temperatures between +15 °C and +25 °C.
2.8 Shelf life. Sika Boom® AP has a shelf life of 12 months from the date of production, if stored properly in undamaged, original, sealed packaging, and if the storage conditions are met. Opened cans of Sika Boom® AP must be used within a short period after opening.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2025, Version 03.04) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. The substrate must be clean, sound and homogeneous, free from oils, grease, dust and loose or friable particles. Paint, cement laitance and other poorly adhering contaminants must be removed. Sika Boom®- AP adheres without primers and/or activators. Predampen the substrate with a mist spray of clean water to ensure the foam cures properly and prevent secondary foam expansion.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2025, Version 03.04) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Curing time: Sika Boom® AP is fully cured after 24h (Depending on the foam thickness, ambient and substrate temperature).
    - Cutting time: ~40-60 minutes (Depending on the foam thickness, ambient and substrate temperature).
    - Tack free time: ~10 minutes (Depending on ambient humidity and temperature levels).
4.3 Yield.
    | 500ml | ~25L |
    | 750ml | ~37L |
    | 850ml | ~42L |
    | Consumption can be regulated by adjusting the pressure on the nozzle trigger. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.4 Application. Shake the Sika Boom® AP can well for a minimum 20 seconds before use, repeat shaking after long interruptions of use. Screw application trigger straw nozzle onto the valve of the can. The amount of expanding foam extruded can be regulated by applying more or less pressure on the trigger. Fill deep joints in several layers, allow each layer to cure and expand sufficiently by mist spraying clean water between each layer and allowing sufficient waiting time between layers. Do not fill hollow sections completely as the foam expands during cure. Where small gaps have to be filled use an extension tube. All building elements must be temporarily fixed until the foam has fully cured. Fully cured foam can be cut to shape and painted.
4.5 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment immediately with Sika Boom® Cleaner or Acetone. Once cured, residual material can only be removed mechanically.
4.6 Limitations and important considerations.
    - The minimum can temperature for application must be +10 °C.
    - In order to get a good quality foam, the can temperature should not vary more than 10 °C from the ambient temperature.
    - Protect the can from direct sunlight and temperatures above +50 °C (danger of explosion).
    - For correct curing of the foam, moisture is necessary.
    - Applying insufficient moisture may lead to subsequent unintended foam expansion (post expansion).
    - Do not fill hollow sections completely as the foam expands during cure.
    - Do not use on polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE / Teflon), and silicone, oil, grease and other separating agents.
    - Sika Boom® AP is not resistant to UV light, exterior applications should be protected.
    - Read all safety and technical recommendations prior to use.
4.7 Further documentation.
    - Safety Data Sheet

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature.
    | Optimum | +18 °C min. / +25 °C max. |
    | Permissable | +5 °C min. / +35 °C max. |
5.3 Substrate temperature.
    | Optimum | +18°C min. / +25 °C max. |
    | Permissable | +5 °C min. / +35 °C max. |
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.6):
    - The minimum can temperature for application must be +10 °C.
    - In order to get a good quality foam, the can temperature should not vary more than 10 °C from the ambient temperature.
    - Protect the can from direct sunlight and temperatures above +50 °C (danger of explosion).
    - For correct curing of the foam, moisture is necessary.
    - Applying insufficient moisture may lead to subsequent unintended foam expansion (post expansion).
5.5 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Green building: 3grams/litre as VOC content (ASTM D3960)
    - Thermal conductivity: ~0.033 W/mK (KS M 3809 : 2021)
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika Boom® AP, January 2025, Version 03.04, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/sika_boom_ap.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika Boom®-AP, version 17/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sds-sika-boom-ap.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
